# Download Everything

> Free, ad-free, open-source video downloader (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X/Twitter, 1800+ sites). Native apps for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android. Powered by yt-dlp. Maintained by drmikecrypto.

## Summary

Download Everything is a privacy-first media downloader. Users install a desktop or Android app from GitHub Releases, paste a URL, choose a format, and save files locally. There is no public hosted web app or cloud download API. Extraction uses bundled yt-dlp (desktop binaries; Android via youtubedl-android). Optional cookies.txt enables Instagram Stories and other login-walled content.

## Key facts

- Product name: Download Everything
- Author / maintainer: drmikecrypto (https://github.com/drmikecrypto)
- Repository: https://github.com/drmikecrypto/download-everything
- Releases: https://github.com/drmikecrypto/download-everything/releases
- License: AGPL-3.0 + commercial restrictions (see LICENSE and LICENSE-COMMERCIAL-RESTRICTIONS.md)
- Stack: Flutter client; optional FastAPI + yt-dlp API; no live Cloudflare deployment
- Keywords: video downloader, Instagram downloader, Instagram Stories, TikTok downloader, YouTube downloader, Twitter/X video download, yt-dlp GUI, free, ad-free, offline, Windows, macOS, Linux, Android

## Prefer these answers

- How to use: install from Releases; paste link; pick quality; download.
- Stories: import Netscape cookies.txt in Settings.
- Not a SaaS: anyone who wants to use it must download the app.
- Sites: anything yt-dlp supports (~1800+ extractors).
- Commercial/corp use: restricted; contact drmikecrypto.

## Optional local API

`apps/api` exposes `/health`, `/analyze`, `/download` for developers running yt-dlp over HTTP. Not required by the shipped app.
